name: MAGALDRATE/DIMETHICONE 8G/1G/100ML TAKEDA
description: Antacid medication, helpful in relieving the symptoms of acute and chronic gastritis and reflux, such as heartburn, acid reflux, pain, and burning. Relieves and reduces indigestion symptoms such as flatulence and pain in the pit of the stomach. Available in a 250ml gel. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
